utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Good afternoon, Mr. Robinson.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, good afternoon, Mr. President, everyone. I would like to introduce to the Trial Chamber our legal intern from Australia, Marina Stanisavljevic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Robinson. Mr. Mitchell, I was told by the Registry that we probably need to do a couple of markings, i.e., P4294 and 95 because they were lost. The time for that will not be counted as Prosecution time.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President, Good afternoon. I will go through those two exhibits now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please go to 65 ter 3199, page 137 in the hard copy and 147 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, this is an image that you marked last week, and unfortunately we need to do the markings again, so I'll just ask you to put on this picture the same markings that were done last week. If you can first mark the LZ-1 and LZ-2 grave areas on the left-hand image.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Then the direction to the school.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the third thing is the path that the trucks would take coming from the school to the LZ-2 site. If you can --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Sorry, I don't have anything in my ears.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: You do not hear any interpretation?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Not even original.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Did you turn up the volume? Now are you hearing me, Mr. Karadzic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: No, nothing.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Now do you hear me, Mr. Karadzic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, now I hear. The original probably would be -- yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So I'll say something in English --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: -- and check whether you're hearing the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Yes, I hear. Probably they hear me too.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: Sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. I think we can carry on without having to repeat what has been done. Yes, please carry on, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: That can be tendered, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. That's Exhibit P4294. We are going to replace it. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please now go to page 160 in e-court. It's page 150 in the hard copy. And there are two things I'd like you to mark on this, Mr. Ruez, when it comes up. The first is the rest area that you identified.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the second was an area you marked "Exec" or "Execution" area.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And that was P4295, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, if we can go to page 156 in the hard copy now and 166 in e-court. And, Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us which site the next series of photos relate to.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the area of Petkovci with the execution site at the dam, Karakaj dam.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, of the Petkovci school and the Petkovci dam, which was the first of those locations that was identified by the investigation?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first site was easy to identify because it is the dam which is a well-known place in this area, and the school was located because of the statements of two persons who survived the execution and who went through this detention site, the school of Petkovci, which was at a very close distance and that we could find by asking locally. It was an easy thing to find.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How did you find the dam itself?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: From a map, I would think, and in addition to also the request of aerial imagery.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, page 157 in the hard copy, 167 in e-court. If you can briefly describe this photo to us, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is a photo taken from a helicopter. The school is clearly visible on -- on the -- on the picture, and at the bottom it is the road going to the left to the little place named Petkovci, and to the right it goes to the national road that leads to Karakaj, mainly Zvornik, Zvornik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, how far is it from this school to the site at Petkovci dam?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a close distance of a little bit more than 1 kilometre, maybe 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, 158 in the hard copy, 168 in e-court. If you can briefly describe what this is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a closer view from the facade of the school seen from the road. It's aim is to show a part of the statement of the witnesses, one at least of them having claimed that soldiers were guarding this area, and when people were inside the classroom were standing up, shots were fired in their direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's jump over to page 160 in the hard copy and 170 in e-court. If you can tell us what -- what we're looking at in this image.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the back of the school. This is the location described by the witnesses when they say having stepped out of the vehicle to go towards the entrance of the school having to run between two rows of soldiers who were beating them on the way.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And is there any significance to the steps that we can see in the middle of the picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, because the -- the back of the school is very different from the front, and this is the description that the witnesses gave, and mainly the feature they recognised when they were shown the photograph, to identify that this was indeed the relevant location.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's jump to page 163 now in the hard copy, 173 in e-court.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In the meantime, Mr. Mitchell, we skipped page 159. Can I ask the significance of the arrow which appears on that page. Could we ask the witness. Should we upload it, e-court page 169, I take it.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mm-hmm. Yes. This was the picture just before the close-up on the entrance of the school. The arrow points the -- the building, and the following photograph will be a closer shot of the entrance that can also be seen on this larger view of the school.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's go back to page 163, e-court 173. Thank you, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, if you can describe what we're looking at here, and in particular what those doors leading off to the right are?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. When -- when we later -- I mean, when we first showed this picture, if I remember well, first we showed the picture, and the witness, at least the one I had interviewed, who is the witness KDZ069, said that once having walked stairs going to the upper floor of the school, he -- and was in a corridor and he entered the last school room in this corridor, which is then the last door that can be seen on the right of the -- this corridor.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, 164 in hard copy, 174 in e-court. Now, what does this photo show us?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this one shows, in fact, the classroom in which the witness was. He had described a stove. There was indeed a stove, though the classroom on this picture had been renewed since July 1995, but nevertheless, you could -- there were elements here that were described by him.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: At page 165 in the hard copy, 175 in e-court. If you can tell us what those white circles ...

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is -- though the place was made new, the blackboard, which in fact here is a green board, was still there, and the circles, they mark the holes inside the blackboard, holes that could match shots being fired from the outside towards the inside as the witness described.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And very briefly, the next photo, 166 in the hard copy and 176 in e-court. Is this a close-up of what we saw in the previous picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's a close-up.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to page 170 now, page 180 in e-court. Now, first, Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us what it is we're looking at here and when this photo was taken.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the -- the site to which vehicle after vehicle the prisoners who were inside the school we just went through were taken to. It's the plateau of the dam, of the Karakaj dam, which is an artificial lake from where the waste of an aluminum factory is pumped into. And at this plateau at the bottom of the lake is a large, very large, flat area which was the place where the prisoners were then taken for execution.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you orient us and tell us where's the water in the dam? Which direction would that be in this picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Should I mark the photograph?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I think you can just describe it in this one.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The flat area being the plateau at the left of the picture is in fact the wall of the dam, and at the top of this elevation, totally at the end of it, is in fact the top of this barge. And the line at the right is the dirt road that leads then to the asphalt road, and very close to the junction there is the school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Page 172 in the hard copy, 82 in e-court, please. And if you can describe this photo to us, have you starting with the road on the very left of the picture. Can you tell us where that comes from?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The road is the same one than the -- on the previous picture. It's a better view. It shows in fact the direction from where the trucks were taking the prisoners to this plateau, and with a much, indeed, better view of the size of this plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: What's the small inset picture and the blue arrow pointing to? What's the significance of that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the photograph in the little box is, in fact, the witness whose code-name I previously gave. It was a day where we could bring him back in this area. We couldn't go inside the school because of the presence of many people, but we could go back to the plateau. And this is the more or less precise point where he was standing to show where he was roughly at the time he was executed there.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you could just read out his code-name again just to make it clear who we're talking about.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The witness KDZ069.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall what year this photo was taken in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it was in 1998.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we go to the next page, please, 173 in the hard copy and 183 in e-court. If you can describe to us first what the feature is in the bottom right foreground of the picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is a view from another angle of this plateau. Where the white vehicles are at their right is the direction of the school. At the right of the vehicles, not behind the vehicles, this is another one leading to the top of the -- of the dam. And at the right is a concrete ditch. The goal of this photo is to show a feature described by the two survivors of this spot who managed to crawl out of this plateau and then entered, according to what they said, a ditch, concrete ditch. This is a ditch.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 174 in hard copy, 184 in e-court. Now, we can see on this image a black line and two blue arrows. If you can tell us first what the black line is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The black line is the limit of the -- what I call the plateau. The red area is indeed the -- the colour of the lake, which is chemical waste. The arrows, in fact, mark the -- the direction that the two survivors claim having taken. After having crawled inside the ditch, they crawled into a wooden area, which is a little -- in fact little wood, just on top of the small hill just in front of the plateau, and from there they took the direction the following day, the 15, the direction that is shown by the second blue arrow that goes on top of another -- of another hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: That's the dotted blue arrow.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the second dotted blue arrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the road that leads out the top of the picture, where does that go to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one is the road leading to the school.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could we see the concrete -- concrete ditch on this picture?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Perhaps if you can mark it --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- on this picture, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: -- I think we do indeed. The small white line should be the one.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Uh-huh. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We should save that, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I think if you can initial and date it, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. That will be the next Prosecution exhibit.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit 4300, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Page 175 in the hard copy, 185 in e-court, please. Again we can see two blue arrows in this image, Mr. Ruez. If you can tell us what those two arrows represent.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The same situation than on the previous one seen from another angle. The arrows show the direction of the escape route of the two survivors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, 176 in hard copy, 186 in e-court. If you can tell us what the significance of this particular image is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: After the night during which the execution -- execution occurred, the night between the 14 and 15 July, on 15 July, the two survivors who were on the little hill in front of the plateau could overlook the situation, and among the things they describe, they saw a little tractor with a trailer on which the bodies were put on, and this little track took the direction of the road that leads towards the top of the hill, the plateau, but they couldn't see where this little vehicle was going. We know that it was only the very beginning of the collection of bodies on the plateau, since later this -- let's say this small tool was replaced by an excavation on the spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you mark on this image the direction that the witnesses told you they saw the tractor going.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the tractor was collecting the bodies who were on the execution area and taking them towards the hill. And probably once arrived in this curve they lost him from sight, since these ones they were sitting on top of this hill here. At one point you cannot see any more the direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The Chamber has heard evidence from Professor Wright who exhumed a grave on the plateau itself. Were there any other areas he -- that were probed?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. In order to -- to find the -- the first groups of bodies collected by this -- this small method, we searched with aerial imagery all the surroundings and couldn't find anything of particular significance, but the area we were focusing on was the -- what we call the peninsula, and here we could just make very, very small probing because there was a lot of chemical waste dumped on top of it, and this led the process to be unrealistic with -- without really specific means.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can put a number 1 inside that area that you just described as the peninsula.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If I can tender that, please, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. That will be Exhibit 4301. Mr. Mitchell, in the previous exhibit, i.e., Exhibit 4300, I was told that the Registry missed the -- Mr. Ruez's initial and today's date, but I think we can do without those things. If you're okay, we can carry on.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Probably for completeness we should go back and put them on there.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we? Shall we upload P4300. Yes. We see the markings of -- yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just put your name and the date. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: And we keep this. Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Page 177 in the hard copy now, and 187 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, can you tell us first who's the person we can see in this picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The person is William Haglund.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: What are objects that we can see laid out on the square in front of Dr. Haglund?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was our first ground fact -- fact-finding mission of April 1996, and we made a very quick surface collection of items scattered on the -- on this plateau and was a collection mainly at this moment of bones. It was certain their origin, and the presence of Mr. Haglund enabled us to be sure that these were human bones.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 178 in hard copy, 188 in e-court. Can you tell us what the object that's circled in yellow is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It is a knotted piece of cloth that was also found on this plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 179 in hard copy, 189 in e-court. If you can describe this?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is again the same piece of cloth.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Page 180 in the hard copy, 190 in e-court. And can you describe this to us, please?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the result of a dig that we did on the surface of the plateau in order to have a possible assessment of what could be found underneath, since at that time we didn't know that the location had already been disturbed and the bodies taken away, but that day at -- at a depth of approximately 1.30 metre, it's quite hot to dig in this rocky place, but nevertheless we could find what the arrow points to is the -- a piece of skull, of human skull.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Who identified that as a piece of skull?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: To be honest, we did without any pathological skills. We -- we could find out it was a human skull. That was not unconfirmed by the pathologist who later saw the picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 181, 191 in e-court.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the -- the bone we -- we took out of the -- this preliminary dig.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this was later shown to an anthropologist, is that correct, Mr. Baraybar?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could be. Maybe. I would not be sure. Anyhow, it has been shown in court many times, and it was never challenged that it was not a human skull.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, 182, page 192 in e-court. Can you describe what those objects are and who labelled them?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this was from, I think, even another mission where again, yes, a side -- yes, okay. Now I remember. It was during a mission where we collected shell casings on the surface of this plateau, and among also these shell casings, in one area we found a lot of pieces of bones, that we collected some of them, and Jose Baraybar was present with us, and he sorted them out by name according to the location they occupy in the human skull. It's all bits and pieces of skull, which was nevertheless interesting since one witness overheard one of the killers saying to another one to stop shooting the people in the head because the spill of the brain became, after a while, too stinky. And these bones were found on the surface of the plateau.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We see in the top right-hand corner the number 1997. Is that the year of this particular mission?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, indeed. It was in -- in 1997.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at the next page, please, 183 in the hard copy, 193 in e-court. Can you tell us what is significant about this photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the -- the result of the -- the -- the search of the surface to collect shell casings. The goal of the -- all these collections of shell casings is designed to later on compare these shell casings with those that could be found either in the primary graves or when transported together with the bodies in the secondary graves. It's one of the links that allow us later to reconstruct the move of these bodies between execution site, primary grave, and secondary grave.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Are those shell casings in the four plastic bags that we see down the very bottom of this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can't recall precisely if this was the final or if it was still ongoing, but most probably it's the amount that was found still on the surface, indeed, here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall roughly how many there -- how many shell casings were recovered from the surface?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: From the surface I think it was around a thousand in total.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at the next page, please, 184 in hard copy, 194 in e-court. Can you explain to us the significance of the area that's bounded by the yellow dotted line?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This -- this marks roughly the area where we found the shell casings on the surface. So one can conclude that this is roughly the -- the size of the execution area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Is this also the area where the skull fragments were found?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not on the total area. I think there might be some mapping of that that could have been done later by Professor Wright. I'm not sure, but it was not on the total of the surface. It was only one part of it. In fact, more at the bottom right of the -- of this -- of this area, if I remember well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's move to another area. Page 185 in the hard copy, 195 in e-court. Can you tell us the next series of photos that we're going to look at.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mm-hmm.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: What location do they relate to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the -- the third detention centre we found in the area north, which is in connection with also, like all of them, with a nearby execution site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And what's the name of that site, the detention site first?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The detention site is the school of Rocevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And the name of the associated execution site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's the execution site of Kozluk at the edge of the Drina River.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we go to page 186 in the hard copy, 196 in e-court. Can you describe what we've looking at here, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the school of the area named Rocevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: When you took this image, had it been confirmed yet that this was a detention site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Honestly, I thought about it and I don't remember precisely. It might not be the case that when I took the picture we already had the certainty that this was indeed the location of detention of those killed at Kozluk, but since it was the only school nearby, I might have taken it, let's say, in advance. But anyhow, their testimony is already in records, I believe, I'm not even sure, of the members of the Bosnian Serb Army who were guarding the prisoners in this school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: When you say "testimonies," you're referring to statements --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Statements.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- witness statements?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So for sure this is indeed the school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, 187 in e-court -- or 187 in hard copy, 197 in e-court. And is this the same school at Rocevic in this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Absolutely, yeah. It's a better view that shows the size of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Does this school also have a gym attached to it?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. You can see the gym bottom left of -- I mean the left of this building. It's a bit of the same style type of gym. It is more or less exactly the same type of gym than the one of the school at Orahovac. It's exactly the same style of gym with the wardrobe in front.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Page 188 in hard copy, 198 in e-court. This is another map. If you can just explain to us the significance of the yellow circle and the Red Star almost directly beneath it.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The yellow circle symbolises the location of the school, and the Red Star the position of the execution site, which is at the end of the dirt road leading from Kozluk to this spot, which is along the bank of the Drina River. To go from the school you have first to drive along the asphalt road towards Kozluk, and inside Kozluk take the turn toward this -- this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How far, just roughly, is it from the Rocevic school to this site at Kozluk?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Less than 4 kilometres.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at the next page, please, 189 in the hard copy, 199 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, can you tell us how you first came to identify this site at Kozluk?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We identified the site quite late, because all the processes were ongoing. The reconstruction of the events, I describe it as one phase, but it's a phase that continued during all the years the investigation lasted, even after my departure. This one we got information, in fact, from a source who was in a refugee camp in Germany, and the person was still in contact with local friends in Republika Srpska, and the witness in Germany heard that prisoners had been taken and shot at a location name the Ferida pit, because this is an area of gravel that is taken for construction, and the pits have names, and the location was Ferida pit. So we -- the first thing we tried to identify was this area of gravel, but since we had no contacts with any locals in the area, we found in fact the place through an imagery request.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 190 in hard copy, 200 in e-court. Can you explain what the significance of this photo is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: What happened is that during one of the missions in 2008, I happened to be at the exhumation site of the secondary gave in the valley of Cancari, on a site we name -- I mean, it's one of these graves, the number further in this road. And at the moment I was there, they happened, the exhumators happened to find a stack of labels, an embottlement of bottles on which was written Vitinka Kozluk, and the only place we had never been to so far was to make a probe -- check and probe this Ferida pit place. So we -- the following day we went for a very quick mission to this location because I knew that the Vitinka factory in Kozluk was most certainly the area -- close to the area where we were trying to find the execution site. So this is, in fact, the labels which then were found in this secondary grave. They connect to this embottlement factory.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And that was 1998 rather than 2008; is that right?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry. 1998, indeed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, what was this factory being used for when you visited the site in 1998?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, one part of it, or at least just next to it was where the barracks of a unit named the Drina Wolves, which belongs to the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 190 in the hard copy -- 191 in the hard copy, 201 in e-court.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The location is just at the beginning of the dirt road that leads to the execution site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Is this the same factory that we see in this image here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. At the left is the factory, and here is the entrance of this military unit, the Drina Wolves.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this photo was taken in 1998; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How far are the Drina Wolves' barracks from the execution site at Kozluk?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's a one-way road, and the site is at 1 kilometre.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, 192 in hard copy, 202 in e-court. Now, we're looking at a split aerial image with two images, one dated 5 July 1995, one dated 17 July 1995. And you'd previously mentioned that you made a request for imagery. Is this what you received in response to that request?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is the -- the one we were looking for and that enabled us to -- to easily find the spot since, as one can see, the area of disturbance is clearly visible.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 193 in hard copy, 203 in e-court. And can you tell us when this photo was taken and what's significant about it?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said, when we were present during the exhumation of -- of the secondary grave, there were labels, but there was also a lot of -- of bits and pieces of green glass of bottles, and this is the one spot in all this disturbed area where you can see not only the pieces of bottles but also on the right is a -- is a shoe, and inside is a -- is still a human feature inside the shoe.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall what year this was taken in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was during this just go-and-return mission that we did with Jan Kruszewski and Professor Wright.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Probably June, June or where along summer 1998.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go to the next page, please, 194 in the hard copy, 204 in e-court. If you can just describe this to us and in particular the object that is next to the yellow tag on the blade of the shovel.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Among the items of interest that we could see on the surface of the disturbed area were also shell casings, and in this particular photograph the shell casing is inside the shovel next to the little yellow marker.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can we go to the next photo, 195 in hard copy, 205 e-court. Is this a close-up of the previous image that we saw?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is, the same one.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to 196 in hard copy, 206 in e-court. And this is the last photo for this site. If you can describe to us what we see here.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Whilst we started to dig a little bit, in fact we quickly stopped since we were in fact beginning an exhumation since just under the soil we already found human bones with clothing and ...

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I want to play now a video of the Kozluk site. That's 65 ter 40280A. And as with the videos last week, Mr. Ruez, we'll turn off the sound and ask you to describe what we're looking at.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So this is one part of the area of disturbance. That's the -- that's the human remains that were on the previous picture. In fact, this one we didn't dig it out. It was just lying on the ground.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: For the record, that was around 35 seconds.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The -- the shoe with the sock and the bone inside, also lying on the ground.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: That was at 58 seconds.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Another shoe. Stacks of fiber glass also in many locations. So shell casings. Many of them were -- when we -- we used a metal detector just on the dirt path that goes along the area of disturbance, and there were quite many of them embedded in the soil there. At this moment, filmed just next to the yellow markers. Clothing, shoes. Shell casing. A shoe with a bone in it. So that's indeed a check by digging just a little bit, but as I said, we would have started an exhumation there. Though the site had been quite thoroughly disturbed and the bodies taken away, there were still a lot of elements visible even on a very quick check like we did that day. And the location is also and was a cemetery. So there are also remnants of this cemetery.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Did you find any other headstones like the ones we just saw?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We didn't check for that, but here is one of those labels that we found in the secondary grave that we can also see here. Makes the connection with the site.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're now at around 4 minutes, 15 seconds. If you can describe what we're looking at here very briefly and then -- then we'll stop.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this was a short film I took when we exited this area. So a quick walk along the factory and mainly the entrance of the barracks of the Drina Wolves.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we stop there, please. Can I tender that, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: That will be admitted as the next Prosecution exhibit.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit 4302, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we please go back to 65 ter 3199, page 197 in the hard copy, page 207 in the e-court.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And, Mr. Ruez, can you tell us what is the next location that we're going to look at?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the next location is, again, a detention site with a nearby execution site. It's the detention site of Kula, and the execution site of the Branjevo Farm.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And does the yellow circle on the map here indicate where the Kula school is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It's a rough indication of the location of the Kula school.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please go to page 198 in the hard copy, 208 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, can you tell us how did you first come to learn that this school had been used as a detention site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The initial knowledge came from one survivor of -- of this spot. In fact, there were two of them. And then it could be found due to the fact that in this area there -- it's the only one which has a gym attached to it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you see the name of that survivor who provided you with the initial information? Is his name on the list in front of you?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, both of them, I think, provided the information.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can read out their witness codes, if you can see them in front of you.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. The witness KDZ333 and KDZ167.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please. That's 199 in the hard copy, 209 in e-court. Now, what does this photo show, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one shows the -- the gravel road that leads to the school, the point where the buses arrived and off-loaded the prisoners.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next photo, please. Number 200 in hard copy and 210 in e-court. Now, what are we looking at in this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's then the little path that leads to the entrance of the -- the school, where they went by foot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you actually see the main entrance on this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. It is right after the angle of this first building.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next photo, 201 in hard copy, 211 in e-court. Is this the main entrance to the school here?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It's the entrance and also the exit. This is the location where one of the witnesses, at least one, says that he was lined up with others prior to be taken to the Branjevo Farm. This is both the entrance and the exit.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And which witness was that, if you can tell us his code-name.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would not be able to say which -- which of the two.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Maybe the two.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 202 in hard copy, 212 in e-court. We're looking at another photo of the school from the air, and Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us the significance of the arrow pointing to a particular location which says, "Water source."

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: One of the witnesses who was kept inside the gym at one point was tasked with -- I mean, to go and fetch water to bring inside the gym, and he said having been to a very close-by water source from which, when he returned, he saw a bus who arrived very late in the night, and the prisoners were off-loaded off this bus, but since the location was probably already stuffed with people, these ones were executed right on the spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall which of the two witnesses this particular one is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's the younger of the two. I don't remember if it was 333 or 167, but he's the younger of the two.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 203 in the hard copy, 213 in e-court. What's the feature we're looking at in the centre of this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the water source. We're looking around to find the water source. We found this one, and indeed he later recognised the picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Did you go to the location with this particular witness?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. We didn't go back with the witness to this location. I don't think so.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: So how did the witness recognise this particular location?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think by picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 204 in hard copy, 214 in e-court. If you can describe what we're looking at here and what the significance of the orange arrow that's pointing out towards the bottom of the picture is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So the -- the orange -- orange arrow, in fact, is the line of sight that one can have when exiting the location where the water pump is. So this is when coming from the direction, that direction, that he saw the prisoners who were taken off the bus, which was parked along the gravel road at the -- at the front of the picture and where they were just off-loaded and shot at on the spot.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 205 in the hard copy, 215 in e-court. Just briefly if you can tell us what the structure is we're looking at here and what the significance of the red circle right in the centre of the picture is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In order to check his -- his statement regarding this small execution at -- at the school, we are looking for left traces among which on the facade of the building where this execution allegedly took place there was, for example, one hole in the window.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 206 in hard copy, 216 in e-court. And again if you can tell us which structure we're looking at and what's significant about this photo.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So these are also traces on the -- on the wall of the -- this school building.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 207 in hard copy, 217 in e-court. Now, this is the same -- up in the top left-hand corner, it's the same as photo number 200 that we saw earlier. If you can describe now what the significance of this inset photo down the bottom right-hand corner is?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Though this is again consistent with the angle of the shooting that the witness describes, and though holes have been filled, it's obvious that there are still some traces left behind.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Some traces of what exactly?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of holes consistent with bullet holes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 208 in hard copy, 218 in e-court. This page has two photos on it. If you can start with the one at the top and tell us what the significance of the area circled in red is.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the -- this is the area where the people were told having been off-loaded and shot at. The two areas marked in red are areas where we found a concentration of shell casings embedded in -- in the soil. So one area on the gravel road and one more close to the possible execution place nearby the school where the little trees are, at the bottom of them, the foot of them.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall how many shell casings were recovered from these -- these two areas?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I don't. Not a large number. Those were only the ones embedded by people who stepped on them.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 209 in hard copy, 219. We're looking at another map here. We can see a yellow circle above Kula and a red cross next to Branjevo. Can you explain the relationship between those two?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The same symbolics then for the other side. The yellow marker spots the location of the detention site, so here the school of Kula. And the red star, the location of the execution side.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, what first led you to investigate the Branjevo Farm?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The first lead to the Branjevo Farm was the statement given by Drazen Erdemovic after he was shipped to The Hague coming from Serbia, and who gave a description of the farm where he and others executed prisoners from 10.00 in the morning through 3.00 in the afternoon on 16 July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Did these statements of the two survivors assist you in your initial investigation at the site?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, because we had the statement of Drazen Erdemovic before April 1996, and aside a very, very short mission that we did with John Shattuck in January, the main mission was in April, and by then we already had the details -- more details, let's say, from the statement of Drazen Erdemovic than we had from the two survivors.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 210 in hard copy, 220 in e-court. Now, if you can describe this image to us, and perhaps mark it and point out, describe what the buildings are that we can see in this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The prisoners arrived by buses, and the busses were taking this little access path where they were parking. The prisoners unloaded, walked towards this line here. Those buildings are, in fact, a pigstry [sic] here. It's a military farm growing corn and raising pigs. Here pigstry. This is the admin building, and this is a garage. The -- the execution teams were -- had their rest area, number one, just behind this garage. So that's the rest area.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you orient us with the road running along the very top right of the picture that we can just see. Where does that road go to?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: In fact, it goes nowhere. It's a dirt road that then if you take it returns to close by an area named Pilica where there only you have national road going from Zvornik at the south towards Bijeljina at the north. But from the farm you cannot see this -- this asphalt road. The farm is behind a -- a soft hill.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you just put a B next to the area where you marked buses were parked and then initial and date this.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Will that be Exhibit P4303? Yes. Shall we take a break if it is convenient, Mr. Mitchell?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll break for 25 minutes and resume at 4.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, I'd like to go back to the Kula school just briefly. Earlier today, at page 24 I asked whether you had gone to that location with a particular witness, and you said, "No. We didn't go back with the witness to this location. I don't think so." And then a little bit later on, on page 26, I asked you if you recalled how many shell casings were recovered from two areas at the Kula school, and you didn't recall the specific number. What I'd like to do is show you an information report from 20 June 1999, and see if it can assist your recollection on these two points.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If I can pass a hard copy to the witness. This can't be broadcast. Mr. President, there are copies for the Judges up there as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. Ruez, just take your time and read through this information report.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. There.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Does this assist you remembering - --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- whether you went to the Kula school with this witness?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, sure, indeed. Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you tell us what his code is, this particular witness?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: He's the young one. He's KDZ333.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can I just direct you to the top of the second stage. Does that assist your recollection of how many shell casings were recovered from this school?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Absolutely, yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And if you recall, we saw two areas that you had circled in red, a rectangular area on the gravel road and a circular area in some trees. Is that the two areas where these 22 shell casings were recovered from?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The round circle was the one probably where we found the 22 north of the gravel road. Yeah. Well, yes, I mean, that -- these are the numbers. Anyhow, the -- this report is much more accurate than whatever my recollection today of it could be.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, if I could move to add that to our 65 ter list and then have it admitted, we'll make a redacted version and have it uploaded into e-court.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. I take it there's no position from the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Well, Mr. President, I don't think it's really appropriate to be admitting a witness statement in this fashion. I think he's read into the record the answers that are necessary, and I think that would be preferable.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We see a point in Mr. Robinson's observation. We don't need to admit this statement, this report. It's read into the transcript and the witness confirmed the identity of this witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. If I can just put a couple of details in of the report --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- on the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: It's an information report of a visit to the school of Pilica and the Branjevo Farm on 20 June 1999, and the ERN is -- one moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. This is not the statement of this -- this witness. This is a report of Mr. Ruez, and --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: It's a report by Mr. Ruez of his visit to these sites.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Either is fine. Let's go -- it's not very important. Let's continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The ERN of that statement is R1078147 -- R1078149.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please go now to page 211 in the hard copy of the photo book and 221 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, if you can look at this photo in front of you and explain to us what angle we're looking at it from now.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. So it is -- this photo is taken from the -- the little access path that leads to the farm. So at the left you can see the -- the two pigstry buildings, in front the admin building, and at the right of it the garage, and on the field on the right where the helicopter is parked is the area of the execution field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this -- what you describe as the access path, is this the route that the buses took to get into the farm?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we go to the next page, please, 212 in the hard copy, 222 in e-court. I'll ask you to mark some things on this next image. If you can first orient us on the road that's running along the bottom of the picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is the -- the road coming from Pilica to the farm. This is the access road. Where the vehicles are is also the area where the buses were coming to.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can put an arrow in the direction of Pilica on that road.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And if you can put a circle around the garage and mark it with a G.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And then circle the area where the execution took place.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can you see on this image the area where a grave was exhumed by Dr. Haglund in 1996?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can initial and date this, please.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And do you recall what date this particular photo was taken in?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was taken -- I took it from a helicopter. It was the day where -- when Madeleine Albright came -- came on this site. I think this was in 1998, summer 1998.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Any of those buildings that we can see?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry, no. It was much earlier than that, much, much earlier than that. That was end of 1996. End of 1996, probably August 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, the four buildings we can see, the two pigsties, the admin buildings and the garage that you've described, are they still there today?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, not at all. Now there is a village on this spot. I returned there. It was in 2002 and there was nothing left. The only thing I could find on that trip was foundation of one part of the pigstry buildings. There is still absolutely nothing left from this place. Now it is a village.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: May I tender that, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: A settlement of houses.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit 4304, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page we'll look at is 213 in the hard copy, 223 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us which building it is that we can see on the far left of this picture.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is precisely the area where the prisoners were marching towards. At the left is the garage, behind which the execution teams had their rest area, and this tree is a tree that one of the witness referred to also in one of the statements, saying that there was this -- this tree just before the -- the area where they had to line up after the -- the rows of bodies of those who had already been killed there. The tree is something he describes also.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The open area we can see on the right-hand side of the picture, if -- past the tree, what's the significance of that open area?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the execution field now.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, please, 214 in hard copy, 224 in e-court. Can you describe where we are now, where this photo was taken?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this photo was -- I took it at the moment we went there for a very short incursion, just to check if the location was the good one, and in this area here, which is in fact after the garage to the left, here we are right on the area of the execution, we were beginning to find some -- some shoes and some human bones that were, in fact, along this -- along this line of trees, of bushes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're going to look briefly at some of the items you found. Can we go to the next page, 215 in hard copy, 225 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us what this item is and where it was found?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This was a shoe found in the bushes in the area seen on the previous photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: The next page, 216 in hard copy, 226 in e-court. Again, if you can tell us what those are, what these objects are, and where they were found.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: These ones were found in the same area, at this tree line and bush line, and these are human bones. A rib, a piece of pelvis, and another bone.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Who identified them as human bones?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: They were later identified on -- based on the photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And who was that by?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Sorry?

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Who did the identification?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't remember to who we showed them. It could be probably to Bill Haglund at that time. It was probably to Mr. Haglund.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Could we go to the next page, please, 217 in around copy, 227 in e-court. What can we see in this photo and where was it found?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is also in this line of -- of bushes, and this is a human skull.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Go to the next page, please, 218 in the hard copy, 228 in e-court. Now, this is an aerial image dated 17 July 1995, the Branjevo state farm. Mr. Ruez, if you can tell us what the significance of the two dotted yellow lines in the middle left of the picture are?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: On one of the missions we did on this farm, we made a collection process of finding shell casings on the surface of this area, and this is a rough indication, shorter than the reality of what we found, but to be conservative it is shorter and narrower. And this is the rough area where we collected shell casings on the surface, knowing that this area had already been used for agricultural purposes and that most probably most of the shell casings were no longer on the surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 219 in e-court -- 219 in hard copy, 229 in e-court. Now, Mr. Ruez, we can see two different coloured labels on this image. Can you explain why there are two different colours?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. In fact, it's a combination of the label -- the yellow ones, I -- I made them with the red arrows showing the direction of the arrival of the buses. The white ones are the original markings of the provider, but the orange ones are also the ones of the provider, except "Excavator digging." It was not labelled as such. It might have been labelled "Heavy equipment," or something like this, but "Probable bodies," "Piles of earth," and on the top line of "Bodies," this was on the original picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go briefly to 65 ter 3959. When it comes up, this is another -- an aerial image. My apologies, 3959. This is an aerial image dated 17 July 1995. Can you tell us who put these markings on this particular image. Is this the original image from the provider which you used to make the orange markings on the photo in the book you've just seen?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm quite sure that it is, but it's a strange picture, because what is white is black and reversed. So everything is reversed. It's like a negative of a picture. It's completely reversed. The colours are the opposite. What is white should be black, and what is black should be white. So I would not be able to fully confirm it's the original one, because the original ones always have the writing on -- black on white. Here it's -- everything is opposite. Everything what is black should be white and everything what is white should be black.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, if I could hand the witness a hard copy of the image in the form we received it in.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we put it on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I recognise it without any problem. This is the original one, indeed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Is this image the basis for the orange markings that are on page 119 of your book?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I tender that, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can you explain the difference between the hard copy and -- and the one which is in the e-court?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The original one is in the normal black and white colours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. I'm asking Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Oh, sorry.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Because you were not able to explain this. Yes, Mr. Mitchell.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Mr. President, I've -- I believe it's -- it's the same image. It's something to do with, I believe, the way it was scanned in.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Oh, you can scan this one again.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can I hear from Mr. Robinson, if you have any objection or any observation?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The original can be scanned again and tendered.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we give the number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4305, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If we can go back to 65 ter 3199, page 220 in the hard copy and 230 in e-court. Again, we have two aerial images. The one on the left dated 21 September 1995, and the one on the right dated 5 July 1995. Can you tell us the significance of the yellow arrow that we can see in the bottom half of these two images?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The yellow arrow shows the location where on 5th July was nothing disturbed on the soil, and on the 21st, the area of disturbance where the location of the mass grave can be clearly seen.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 221 in the hard copy and 231 in e-court. Can you describe what this is in this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, these are human remains that were on the surface at the time we went there for the very first entrance in the farm, and this was found right at the -- at the end of the grave. It's something that has obviously been pushed by the -- the heavy machine and left in the -- in the bushes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I'm going to play a video now of this site, and again we'll turn the sound off and I'll ask you to describe what we're seeing. It's 65 ter 40227A.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So it's a helicopter video here over-flying the school of Kula, and following the dirt road that goes towards Pilica to show the distance. So still following the road. And then it will arrive at the Branjevo Farm. And here is the Branjevo Farm. Here I'm zooming to the area where the grave is. Here is -- here are the buildings. And this is now where the settlement has been built. And here we are above the grave. Now it's from the ground.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Now, for the record, we're at 4 minutes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So these are objects still -- still around on the surface. This is the piece of body that has been pushed by the machine that is on the photograph. This is again another date. It's a mixture of pictures taken from various missions on this spot. This one is filmed by Peter Nicholson.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: What's the building we can see --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the garage, the tree, and in this direction the way the prisoners were marched towards. This is the admin buildings. The pigstry is behind the two. The garage. And the area where we will do the shell casing collection. And this is the execution field, the grave being just after the trees to the left.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And that is at 6 minutes, 2 seconds.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The back of the garage. And the field. The -- the yellow markers spotting shell casings which were visible on the surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Where's this particular bit of footage being shot from?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is the shot on the area that -- that shows not exactly the size of the execution area because these shell casings have been also moved around by the heavy equipment that was used to collect the bodies on the surface, but also by some agricultural machinery that later on was probably used to -- to seed the field. So the area where we found the shell casings is larger than the -- the actual area, but it's still a very large surface. This is the area leading towards the grave.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: I think we can stop there. My apologies. If we can keep playing. That was at 9 minutes, 11 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: If you can tell us where this bit of footage is, Mr. Ruez.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is a bridge under which the witness did hide after having crawled away from the -- the execution site and where he did spend the night. He described that it was a bridge with a lot of trash underneath and bits of vehicles also. So the first thing we did show to him before that was already photographs of the area, but when we came back with him, indeed he -- he again confirmed this was the spot. It's under this bridge.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: How far is this bridge from the farm?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not very far away, less than a kilometre. He is also the witness who the day after saw a truck loaded with -- with dead bodies that drove along the -- the road coming from the direction of where Pilica is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you tell us his witness code?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. KDZ333.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And can I tender that video, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit P4306, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we please look at page 222 in the hard copy of your book and 232 in e-court. Mr. Ruez, if you can explain to us what the next site is that we're going to look at and how you first came to learn of this site.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: We -- we learned from this site from only one source, which is the statement of Drazen Erdemovic, who said that once the execution at the Branjevo Farm was completed, security officer on the spot told them that there were still some 500 prisoners to be executed nearby at the Dom of Culture in Pilica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, 223 in the hard copy, 233 in e-court. And can you tell us the significance of the two buildings that are pointed out in this image?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Drazen Erdemovic, with the team of the 10th Sabotage Detachment went with this security officer to have some drinks in a cafe that was at the opposite side of the road, and on the other side of the road was the location where the people were locked inside and where the other team of -- of killers who came from Bratunac shot the people inside the -- this place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: And this is the town or village of Pilica --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes --

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: -- that's in this picture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the village of Pilica where we ended up finding the -- both the cafe and the house of culture of Pilica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can you orient us on the road that runs through the middle of town. As it exits out the bottom of the photo, which direction is that?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: At the bottom of the photo is the direction of Zvornik, and at the top it is the direction of Bijeljina. The -- the border limit of the Drina Corps is just at the exit north of this village.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 224 in hard copy --

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: And on this -- on this picture also there is a bus just in front of the Dom of Culture, exactly in the position where the people were taken to go to this Dom of Culture from Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: We're looking at 224 now in hard copy, 234 in e-court. What's this building on this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is how at the time looked the front facade of the Dom of Culture. The first floor was the office of the mayor and at the ground floor a little telephone communication centre.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 225 in hard copy and 235 in e-court. What is the building in this photo?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the cafe just in front of the Dom of Culture, the cafe where Erdemovic and the few others of the 10th Sabotage Detachment had their drinks.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: In the very left bottom foreground of the picture, is that the edge of the road that we can see?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Absolutely, yes. This is the asphalt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 226 in hard copy, 236 in e-court. Can you tell us where this photo was taken from and what you can see.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So on this one, this one is taken from the inside of the cafe. Through the window you can see the Dom of Culture. The actual entrance and exit of the theatre behind this building where the people were locked into cannot be seen because there is a metal structure that hides the place. So Erdemovic could not see precisely what was going on inside, but he could see that those prisoners who could run out were then shot in -- in the street.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: In between this cafe and the Dom of Culture that we can see, the main Zvornik-Bijeljina road is running between those two buildings?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Just behind the parking spot where the vehicles are seen is the asphalt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we go to the next page, please, 227 in hard copy, 237 in e-court. What does this photo show, Mr. Ruez?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one shows the complete structure of this building, and where the soldier is standing in front is a blue door, and that is the entrance door of the -- of the Dom of Culture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: So when you say the complete structure of this building, this is -- this whole building is the Dom of Culture?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: The entire building is the Dom of Culture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at the next page, please, 228 in hard copy, 238 in e-court. What does this photo show?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: This one shows on the left the door that leads upstairs to the area where the projectionist who shows films inside the Dom of Culture has to go up to, and the door on the right is the entrance, the main entrance of the Dom of Culture. And this room, when we arrived, had a locker on it. Some -- in fact, it was clear once inside that no one had been there before us in between the time of the events and the day we -- we enter the room.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Can we look at the next page, please, 229 in hard copy, 239 in e-court. And is this the lock on the door that you just mentioned?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is the locker on the door, and you can also see in between the doors that there is an old spider nest. This place is locked since a while.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Do you recall the date of when you first entered the Pilica Dom?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: Not precisely but it was probably at the end of summer 1996.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Let's go to the next page, 230 in hard copy, 240 in e-court. Can you describe where we're looking at now and where this photo was taken from?

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
utterances.text: So this is taken from upstairs from the whole of the cabin of the projectionist. This is the first view of the inside of the Dom of Culture.

utterances.speaker: MR. MITCHELL
utterances.text: Next page, please, 231 in hard copy, 241 in e-court. Can you tell us who this person is in this photo and what they're doing.

utterances.speaker: JEAN-RENE RUEZ [Resumed]
